messages:
tara: tossing up a small feature: a routing "what-if" panel that shows per-invocation and per-token cost deltas before changing rules. mock: https://img.redwood/whatif :mag_right:
kevin: nice. do we include cache/shared-prefetch impacts or keep it model-only?
anita: include both but call out assumptions. two presets: "cold" and "warmed" so customers see bounds.
tara: agreed. UI should also offer CSV export for finance teams with per-model rows.
ryan: infra note: accurate preview needs sampled token-level telemetry with routing_decision and cache_hit flags. can sample 1% to limit cardinality.
ops-bot: infra patch queued: add-telemetry-routing -> infra/staging (ETA 17:30)
finance-sam: CSV is critical. we need columns: model_sku, quant_profile, baseline_cost, new_cost, delta_pct, expected_qps_shift.
\anke: (typo) anita: also show sample_coverage and a confidence band +/- %. previews without coverage should show a warning.
tara: plan: add telemetry tags, preview API endpoint, sampling job, UI panel + microcopy. i'll open RFC and assign tasks.
kevin: timeline: infra + API in 2 sprints, UI mock in 1. QA A/B after canary.
